description: This file contains a series of shell script tests for verifying the behavior of Git’s worktree references and related reflog and ref-lookup functionalities.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines individual test cases that should succeed, encapsulating setup and assertions.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev
methods.description: Compares Git refs or revisions to verify they are equal.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets up cleanup commands to run after tests are complete.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit, optionally within a specified directory.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script suite.
